issues.description: The template calls printf before pushing its argument (call printf at template lines 16, push hello at template line 17), while the solution pushes the argument before calling printf (push hello at solution line 14, call printf at solution line 15). The problem statement only instructs students to change the register name (ecc -> ecx) and does not mention the printf argument order. This mismatch means the template contains an additional, unmentioned bug: argument push-order for printf differs from the working solution. Students following the problem text exactly (only changing ecc -> ecx) may still end up with code that behaves incorrectly at runtime or be confused why the solution differs beyond the requested change.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template's call sequence match the solution by pushing the argument before calling printf. Concretely, in template_repository/helloWorld.asm reorder the lines so 'push hello' appears before 'call printf' (and remove or update the incidental comment). Alternatively, update the problem statement to explicitly instruct students to fix both the register name and the printf argument order so the extra change in the solution is not surprising.
